title: postapiauthloginwithvalidcredentials
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with valid user credentials returns HTTP 200 and a valid JWT token for authenticated sessions.

title: postapiauthregisterwithadminprivileges
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/register/admin creates a new system admin and returns HTTP 200 OK.

title: getapiproductswithvalidtoken
description: Verify that GET /api/products with a valid JWT token returns HTTP 200 and a list of products.

title: postapiproductswithvaliddata
description: Verify that POST /api/products with valid product data and authentication creates a new product and returns HTTP 201 Created.

title: getapiorderslistwithvalidtoken
description: Verify that GET /api/orders with a valid JWT token returns HTTP 200 and a list of warehouse stock movements.

title: postapiapprovalswithvalidrequest
description: Verify that POST /api/approvals with a valid batch expiry change request and authentication creates a new request with Pending status and returns HTTP 201 Created.

title: getapicategorieswithvalidtoken
description: Verify that GET /api/categories with a valid JWT token returns HTTP 200 and a list of categories.

title: postapicontactswithvaliddata
description: Verify that POST /api/contacts with valid supplier or client contact data and authentication creates a new contact and returns HTTP 201 Created.

title: getapiauditlogwithadminauthorization
description: Verify that GET /api/audit-log with valid admin JWT token returns HTTP 200 and paginated audit log results.
